title: Share of SIDS cases where the baby was placed stomach-down vs. back-up, before vs. after the campaign
time_coverage: Before vs. after Back to Sleep
notes: Among SIDS cases studied, the share of babies placed stomach-down fell from 85.4% to 30.1%, while back-sleeping placement rose from 1.9% to 47.1% -- the behavior flipped as the death rate halved.
